title: Common definitions
description: Identifier, version and reference shapes shared by every other OCF schema.

packId.description: A pack ID: lowercase words joined by hyphens, with dots allowed between them, e.g. `5e-srd-5.1`. By convention `<game>-<pack folder>`.

localId.description: A content ID inside one pack: dot-separated segments of lowercase words joined by hyphens, e.g. `weapons.longsword`, `magic-items.weapon-plus-one`. Content IDs are permanent and never reused.

qualifiedId.description: A content ID with its pack, e.g. `5e-srd-5.1:weapons.longsword`.

ref.description: A reference to content: a local ID (resolved in the referring pack, then its dependencies) or a qualified ID.

typeRef.description: A content type name, local or with its pack (`class`, `specialAbility`, `5e-srd-5.1:class`).

qualifiedTypeRef.description: A content type name with its pack (`fitd-scoundrel:specialAbility`).

fieldId.description: A field ID: dot-separated identifier segments, e.g. `abilities.str.mod`. Segments must be valid formula identifiers (no hyphens), because formulas refer to fields by bare name.

familyKey.description: A key standing for a family of field IDs: a field ID with one or more placeholders, `{<family>}`, each a family the pack declares in `families` (`abilities.{ability}.mod`, `spellSlots.rank{rank}.max`). Expanded before the pack loads: one entry per value, the placeholder replaced in the key and in every string of the entry.

viewFieldsRef.description: The name of a set of declared fields in the pack's `viewFields`, in place of declaring them again.

qualifiedFieldId.description: A field ID with its pack, e.g. `5e-srd-5.1:abilities.str.score`.

name.description: A short identifier usable in formulas: item field names, state keys, parameter names, content type names.

slug.description: A local identifier for choices, actions, steps, bands and similar parts: lowercase words joined by hyphens.

tag.description: A tag on content, fields, rolls and changes: lowercase words joined by hyphens, optionally dotted into a hierarchy (`damage.fire`). A tag matches itself and every tag below it (`damage` matches `damage.fire`). Every tag a pack uses must be declared in its rules' `tags` (or a dependency's).

instanceId.description: An ID unique within one character file, for inventory entries, features and applied effects. Up to 193 characters, so a standard copy's derived ID (its qualified content ID with the colon and dots as hyphens) always fits.

languageTag.description: A BCP 47 language tag such as `en`, `de` or `pt-BR`.

literal.description: A plain data value: a string, number, boolean, or a list of them.

valueType.description: The value types a field, item field, state key or parameter can hold. Kept in sync with `data/value-types.json`.

rounding.description: How a decimal result becomes whole. Kept in sync with `data/rounding-modes.json`.

source.description: Where a value, roll item or rules issue came from.

deprecation.description: Marks something as deprecated. It keeps working; upgrade scripts move characters off it.

tagOrFormula.description: A tag, or `{ formula }` computing tags when the action runs (`{ formula: "'damage.' + item.damageType" }`): one string, or a list of strings spread in the entry's place. Each must be a declared tag; a tag already in the list isn't added again.

tagMembers.description: Which tags an `id` or `set` of `tag` takes: a tag listed in `tags`, or a tag below one in `under` (`damage.fire` under `damage`; `damage` itself isn't), and not listed in `except` (`except: [skill.lore]` leaves the tags below it members). Every tag named must be declared by the pack or a dependency.

under.description: Tags whose descendants are members; the tag itself isn't.

tags.description: Tags that are members themselves (not the tags below them).

except.description: Tags that aren't members themselves; the tags below them still can be.

declaredFields.description: Fields read from another character, by field ID as that character's packs name it, without the pack. Each has a value type and an optional `default`. Link slots declare them. A declared field the other character's view lacks reads its `default`; with none it is absent. `id` is reserved for the view's character ID.

of.description: set: what the members are; only `string`. The view's value is a list of strings, read as is (not qualified).

default.description: The value when the view lacks the field: a literal, never a formula.

immunity.description: Applied content the character can't be affected by: the items listed, or the content a query matches. Decided during activation: an active `applied` entry whose source matches an active immunity is blocked (not activated) and reported as the rules issue `immune`.

id.description: Unique among the owner's immunities. The `immune` issue's ID is the qualified owner plus this ID (`5e-srd-5.1:features.monk.purity-of-body/poisoned`), or the pack plus this ID for the rules'.

items.description: The content the character is immune to, by ID; resolved at load like other references.

query.description: The content the character is immune to, as a query; its `where` sees the candidate as `item` and is an activation condition.

when.description: An activation condition: the immunity counts only while it holds. It reads `self`, `item`, `character` and raw input values, never derived fields.

scope.description: On content: which activations of the item have the immunity, as for effects. `holder` (default): while the character has the item. `applied`: while the item is the source of an active `applied` entry that isn't itself blocked (petrified's immunity to poison). The rules' immunities have no scope.

slotId.description: A link slot ID with its pack, e.g. `fitd-scoundrel:crew`.
